title: Remote viewing Chernobyl three days before it happened

tellings.quote: >> Oh, yeah. Ahead of time. Yeah. Three day three days before it happened.

plain: An Army sergeant and remote viewer named Lyn Buchanan says he picked up the 1986 Chernobyl nuclear disaster in the Soviet Union "three days before it happened." Remote viewing is the practice of trying to perceive a distant target with the mind alone. Buchanan tells Michels this firsthand, and if true it would mean the method could see events before they occur.
